description: This file defines a modern design system for a medical exam prep application, including color palette, typography, spacing, border radius, shadows, and functions to generate global CSS and styled HTML components like metric cards and badges.

methods.name: get_global_css
methods.description: Returns a string containing global CSS styles for the application, including font imports, scrollbar styling, header styles, metric styles, button styles, input styles, tab styles, expander styles, chat message styles, sidebar styles, progress bar, alert boxes, data frame, file uploader, and custom classes.

methods.name: create_metric_card
methods.description: Generates an HTML string for a styled metric card with title, value, optional delta indicator, icon, and color.

methods.name: create_stat_badge
methods.description: Creates an HTML string for a small stat badge with label, value, and badge type.
